latest.headline: GTI_1990 Breaks the Streak in Estonia
latest.paragraph: After a season defined by the dominance of StoryVS_TTV, the narrative finally shifted at the Rally Estonia. GTI_1990 secured their first victory of the season, finishing with a total time of 00:34:50.933 in their Ford Fiesta Rally2. Despite StoryVS_TTV leading early with five stage wins, a time penalty on stage five derailed their campaign, allowing GTI_1990 to capitalize with three stage wins of their own. Janeman13 claimed second place, while speeedhunterr rounded out the podium. This result marks a significant turning point in the WRC2 category standings for Season 5.
